name: Consilience Atlas Full Intake
rules: Return JSON only. Every claim must quote the frozen source exactly.
Every claim, bridge, anchor, and mirror remains candidate. Never return admitted, proved, verified, or isomorphic as a standing.
Keep formal mathematics, empirical evidence, theological interpretation, and source assertions separately labeled.
Use isomorphism_candidate only when a complete directional and function-preserving map is explicitly supplied; otherwise use partial, analogy, or none.
Reality Mirror is top-level metadata, not a Periodic marker. Unknown and unresolved are valid results.
H/P/A/N are independent receipts: Human, deterministic Python, API, and independent NLP. State not_run rather than fabricating a result.
Resonance discovers candidate neighbors. Phi adjudicates a supplied bridge. Neither is admission.
Do not invent external evidence, Lean receipts, source spans, graph counts, or canonical grades.
